description.zh:
排序方式，取值如下：
- Desc：降序。
- Asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `Desc`: descending order

- `Asc`: ascending order

description.zh: 专属资源组列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的专属资源组数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.
The resource group ID. The [CreateResource](~~412111~~) operation returns this ID.

description.zh: 资源组名称。[CreateResource](~~412111~~)会返回资源组名称。
description.en: The resource group name. The [CreateResource](~~412111~~) operation returns this name.

description.zh:
资源组类型，取值如下：

- Dedicated：专属资源组
- SelfManaged：自运维资源组
description.en:
The resource group type. Valid values:

- `Dedicated`: dedicated resource group

- `SelfManaged`: self-managed resource group

description.zh: 排序字段。按时间戳类型默认倒序排序。
description.en: The sort field. Timestamp fields are sorted in descending order by default.

description.zh: 资源组使用模式。默认为 inference
description.en: The usage mode of the resource group. The default value is `inference`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas list-resources --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --resource-name MyResource --resource-id eas-r-h7lcw24dyqztwxxxxxx --resource-type Dedicated --resource-status ResourceReady --usage-mode inference --order Desc --sort CreateTime --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/resources --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ResourceId 'eas-r-h7lcw24dyqztwxxxxxx' --ResourceName MyResource --UsageMode inference --ResourceStatus ResourceReady --Sort CreateTime --ResourceType Dedicated --header "Content-Type=application/json"
